name: 55343 · Hopkins, MN
findings: ZIP 55343 (Hopkins) has 153 nonprofit organizations. 73 of them (48%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 53 organizations.
Health care organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (20% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 55343 (Hopkins) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 55343 (Hopkins) list public events on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 2.1 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 48 organizations here; 24% of all organizations here have no identified type.
